name: Pocket City 3D
author: Cyberdelia
help: Drive about a small city seen from above. Hold Select for the throttle, Prev to brake and reverse, turn the wheel to steer; the wheels come back straight when you let go. Play is the handbrake, for a slide round a corner. Next sounds the horn. Grass and sidewalks slow you down. Phase 1: one district, one car.

options.name: steering
options.title: Steering
options.help: Spin: turning the wheel turns the front wheels, and they come back straight when you stop. Thumb: the wheels follow where your thumb rests, right or left of the top.
